description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the RustAdapter plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, configuration structures, and method signatures for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, and communication with external components.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A plugin class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with given parameters.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Returns the library path or name based on provided libname and callsign.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for the given service and callsign.
